article.story: WASHINGTON -- — Cedric Taylor III scored 27 points as Howard beat Norfolk State 88-60 on Saturday. Taylor added nine rebounds and three steals for the Bison (13-9, 3-3 Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference). Bryce Harris also scored 27 points and added eight rebounds. Jordan Leaks led the Spartans (10-14, 3-4) in scoring, finishing with 13 points. Anthony McComb III added 11 points for Norfolk State. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
